programmes.show_description: 4/3. Another chance to hear Mary Anne Hobbs celebrating Prince's critically-acclaimed album Sign O' The Times, 33 1/3 years after it was first released.
1/3. Two hours of Prince live in concert across a range of different stages and eras. Enjoy a mix of the most intimate of piano-led solo performances as well as electric stadium shows.
2/3. A career celebration, from his 1978 debut through to his untimely death in 2016.
